goal: I want to compare my photos, choose my five favorites, leave any editing notes, and confidently send my selection to the photographer.
workflow: Edit notes for each selected photo
firstView: Shortlist header with count, list of selected photos, and submission controls
primaryAction: Submit the selection or start over

sections.title: Selection Summary
sections.purpose: To show how many photos are selected and provide submission controls

sections.title: Selected Photos
sections.purpose: To display all selected photos with their notes

sections.title: Submission Controls
sections.purpose: To allow submitting or resetting the selection

states.loading: Shows skeleton placeholders while loading shortlist
states.empty: Displays empty state with message 'No photos selected yet' when no selection exists
states.error: Shows error alert if shortlist fails to load
states.success: Displays the list of selected photos with notes and submission controls

responsive: On phone, photo grid becomes vertical list, buttons stack vertically
accessibility: All interactive elements are keyboard accessible and have proper ARIA labels
